'''Congressional Crystalline''' was a manufacturing corporation based in the [[Senate District/Legends|Senate District]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It provided [[clari-crystalline]] windows for the [[Senate apartment complex/Legends|Senate Apartment Complex]], among other buildings in that district.<ref name="NEGD">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
